description: This file defines the CustomerOptionDao interface, which declares data access methods for CustomerOption entities within the customer attribute package, including methods to list options by store and language, save or update options, and retrieve options by code.

classes.name: CustomerOptionDao
classes.description: A DAO interface for handling CustomerOption persistence and retrieval, including methods to list options by store and language, save or update options, and get options by code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOption objects associated with a specific merchant store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerOption or updates an existing one; throws ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a unique CustomerOption identified by its code within a specific merchant store.
